emit_matching: Names are lower-cased; oxidation-state prefixes (fe2+, fe3+, fe2+fe3+, fe3+fe2+, mn2+, fe3+mn) are removed; the first component of a mixture (text before the first '+') is matched against the rules in order; if nothing matches, the whole name is tried. First matching rule wins. species null = ignored (not a mineral class).
unmapped_note: EMIT library entries such as chlorite, vermiculite, beidellite, pyrophyllite, siderite, aragonite, kieserite, serpentine and silica are not in this v1 hierarchy and are ignored; add species here (new version) to count them.
